en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square or street corner, showing cobblestone pavement, rows of pollarded trees within a fenced planting strip, and several two‑ to three‑storey plastered buildings with steep tiled roofs. On the left is a building with an arched entrance and balcony; a horse cart stands nearby. In the center background is a house with signage on the facade. Two men in early 20th‑century clothing stand talking in the open space at right, near stairs leading up to a large gabled house.
